kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتقاسم (form VI)
# نَتَقَاسَمُ (nataqāsamu) /na.ta.qaː.sa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَقَاسَمَ (taqāsama)
# نَتَقَاسَمَ (nataqāsama) /na.ta.qaː.sa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَقَاسَمَ (taqāsama)
# نَتَقَاسَمْ (nataqāsam) /na.ta.qaː.sam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَقَاسَمَ (taqāsama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
